# LaunchDarkly
> Feature management, feature flags, experimentation, and release automation for shipping software safely at scale.

LaunchDarkly helps teams control feature delivery, reduce release risk, run experiments, and manage application behavior in real time across web, mobile, backend, and AI-powered products.

## Platform
- [Platform overview](https://launchdarkly.com/platform/): Overview of LaunchDarkly’s feature management, experimentation, observability, and release capabilities.
- [Feature Flags](https://launchdarkly.com/platform/feature-flags/): Core feature flagging capabilities for controlled rollouts, targeting, and safer releases.
- [Guarded Releases](https://launchdarkly.com/platform/guarded-releases/): Monitor releases and reduce risk with automated safeguards and progressive delivery.
- [Experimentation](https://launchdarkly.com/platform/experimentation/): Run product experiments and measure impact with data-driven decision tools.
- [Observability](https://launchdarkly.com/platform/observability/): Detect, diagnose, and recover from issues with release-aware observability.
- [AI Configs](https://launchdarkly.com/platform/ai-configs/): Manage AI application behavior and configuration changes with control and safety.

## Product Capabilities
- [Feature lifecycle management](https://launchdarkly.com/features/feature-lifecycle-management/): Manage flags from creation through rollout, cleanup, and retirement.
- [Governance](https://launchdarkly.com/features/governance/): Apply policies, approvals, and controls for compliant feature management workflows.
- [Automation](https://launchdarkly.com/features/automation/): Automate release processes, operational tasks, and flag-driven workflows.
- [Platform architecture](https://launchdarkly.com/features/platform-architecture/): Learn how LaunchDarkly’s architecture supports scale, reliability, and low-latency delivery.

## Solutions by Team
- [Developers](https://launchdarkly.com/development-teams/): Feature management workflows tailored for software engineering and application development teams.
- [DevOps & SRE](https://launchdarkly.com/devops-site-reliability-engineer-teams/): Operational controls and safer releases for reliability and infrastructure teams.
- [Mobile apps](https://launchdarkly.com/mobile-app-development-teams/): Release and manage mobile features without waiting for app store approvals.
- [Product managers](https://launchdarkly.com/product-managers/): Use flags and experimentation to coordinate launches and validate product decisions.
